news.title: Netflix Stock Is Down 36% and Wall Street Keeps Downgrading It. History Says That's a Mistake.
news.summary: The streaming giant's rising profitability may help improve overall investor sentiment in the coming months.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價下跌 36% 且華爾街持續下調評級。歷史表明這是個錯誤。
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭不斷提升的獲利能力可能有助於改善未來幾個月的整體投資人情緒。

news.title: Josh Brown: Netflix Can Clear Wall Street’s 10.6% Growth Bar “Standing on Their Head”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysJosh Brown says Netflix can easily beat Wall Street’s 2027 revenue growth estimate, which sits below the 13% growth Netflix guides for 2026. At about 17x forward earnings, Netflix trades at roughly half its five-year average multiple, about Disney’s.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown：Netflix 可輕鬆跨越華爾街的 10.6% 成長門檻，「倒立」也能過關
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Josh Brown 指出 Netflix 可輕易擊敗華爾街的 2027 營收成長預估，該預估低於 Netflix 為 2026 指引的 13% 成長。以約 17x 遠期盈餘計算，Netflix 交易價格約為其五年平均倍數的一半，接近 Disney。

news.summary: The likelihood of users recommending Netflix or Net Promoter Score is now +51 vs. +53 a year ago, according to Worldpanel by Numerator, a consumer and shopper behavior researcher.
news.title: Fixing Netflix's Growing Subscriber Satisfaction Problem
news.title_zh: 解決 Netflix 日益嚴重的訂戶滿意度問題
news.summary_zh: 根據消費者與購物行為研究機構 Numerator 的 Worldpanel 數據，用戶推薦 Netflix 的可能性或淨推薦分數目前為 +51，而一年前為 +53。

news.summary: Today's big story: Could Anthropic Stock Fall 25.
news.title: Why Netflix's Fall Could Pay Off At Tax Time
news.title_zh: 為何 Netflix 下跌在報稅時可能獲利
news.summary_zh: 今日重大消息：Anthropic 股票會下跌 25 嗎？

news.title: Netflix Just Dropped 15% in a Month. Is There “More Pain” Ahead, or Is It Time to Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNetflix stock fell 15% in the past month after a soft fourth-quarter outlook and a cut to its 2026 ad revenue forecast, to about $2. 7 billion from about $3 billion.
news.title_zh: Netflix 一個月內下跌 15%。未來還有「更多痛苦」，還是該加碼買進？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要：Netflix 股價在過去一個月下跌 15%，因第四季展望疲軟且將其 2026 廣告收入預測下調至約 $2。7 billion 從約 $3 billion。

news.title: With Netflix Stock Down Nearly 46% In The Last Year, Michael Burry Reveals The Price He’d Think About Buying
news.summary: Michael Burry says Netflix has finally caught his eye, but only at a price far below where it trades today. His shifting number, and a milk versus wine theory about content, reveal what he thinks a streaming library is really worth.
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價在過去一年下跌近 46%，Michael Burry 揭露他考慮買進的價格
news.summary_zh: Michael Burry 表示 Netflix 終於引起他的注意，但僅限於遠低於當前交易價格的水平。他不斷變動的數字，以及關於內容的「牛奶對葡萄酒」理論，揭示了他認為串流媒體庫的真實價值。

news.summary: Today's big story: Could Anthropic Stock Fall 25.
news.title: What Are Netflix Stock Bears Missing?
news.title_zh: Netflix 空頭錯過了什麼？
news.summary_zh: 今日大事：Anthropic 股價會下跌 25 嗎？

news.title: Netflix Is 48% Below Its High While Guiding to Record Revenue of $51.1 Billion, Up 13%, for 2026
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNetflix hit a new 52-week low this week, 48% below its high a year ago, while guiding 2026 revenue to a record $51. 1 billion.
news.title_zh: Netflix 低於其高點 48%，同時指引創紀錄收入 $51.1 Billion，增長 13%，針對 2026
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Netflix 本週觸及新的 52 週低點，較一年前高點低 48%，同時指引 2026 收入達創紀錄的 $51。1 billion.

news.title: Nick Khan on Making WWE a Global Media Power
news.summary: In this episode of The Deal, Alex Rodriguez and Jason Kelly talk with WWE president Nick Khan at Bloomberg’s Screentime conference about his deals with Netflix and ESPN. (Source: Bloomberg)
news.title_zh: Nick Khan 談打造 WWE 成為全球媒體強權
news.summary_zh: 在《The Deal》這一集中，Alex Rodriguez 和 Jason Kelly 在彭博 Screentime 大會上與 WWE 總裁 Nick Khan 對談，討論他與 Netflix 和 ESPN 的交易。（來源：彭博）

news.title: Skydance Skips FIFA World Cup Bid as Netflix, Fox Eye $4 Billion Deal
news.summary: Skydance Corp. and Walt Disney Co.’s ESPN have declined to bid for the US media rights for the next FIFA Men’s World Cup tournament in what could be one of the costliest and competitive auctions in the global soccer event’s history, according to people familiar with the matter.
news.title_zh: Skydance 放棄 FIFA 世界盃標案，Netflix、Fox 覬覦 $4 Billion 交易
news.summary_zh: 據知情人士透露，Skydance Corp. 和 Walt Disney Co. 旗下的 ESPN 已拒絕競標下一屆 FIFA 男子世界盃賽事的美國媒體版權，這可能是全球足球賽事歷史上最昂貴且競爭最激烈的拍賣之一。

news.title: Josh Brown Says Netflix Trades at 16 Times Next Year’s Earnings After a 50% Drop. Is It a Buy?
news.summary: Josh Brown once called Netflix his biggest mistake of the year, then watched the stock sink even further. Now he sees a bargain hiding in the wreckage, but the bear case has real teeth, and one upcoming report could settle the debate.
news.title_zh: Josh Brown 指出 Netflix 交易價為 16 Times 倍明年盈利，此前下跌 50%。是否值得買入？
news.summary_zh: Josh Brown 曾稱 Netflix 為他年度最大錯誤，隨後目睹股價進一步下挫。如今他看見殘局中藏著便宜貨，但空頭論點確有威力，即將到來的一份報告可能終結辯論。

news.title: Netflix Stock Just Closed Below $60 for the First Time Since August 2024. I'd Buy It Now.
news.summary: The streaming giant's shares have hit the price I said I'd pay. Is there a good reason to wait longer?
news.title_zh: Netflix 股價剛收盤跌破 $60，為自 August 2024 以來首次。我現在會買入。
news.summary_zh: 這家串流巨頭的股價已觸及我說會買入的價格。還有好的理由再等待嗎？

news.title: S&P and Dow enter correction territory, Nasdaq turns red for the year amid AI rout
news.title_zh: 標普與道瓊進入修正區間，納斯達克因 AI 殺盤轉為年度下跌

news.title: Chart Of The Day: A Tale Of Two 'Safe Havens'
news.summary: The stock market is sliding. Tech stocks are getting tossed out. And investors are seeking safe havens. Two typical refuges in times of market turmoil are behaving differently - GLD and TLT.
news.title_zh: 每日圖表：兩大「避風港」的故事
news.summary_zh: 股市下滑。科技股被拋售。投資人尋求避風港。市場動盪時的兩大典型避難所——GLD 和 TLT——表現截然不同。

news.title: Bond ETFs Haven’t Been This Rewarding in Years, So Why Is Wall Street Dumping Them?
news.summary: Investors are fleeing bond funds just as new bonds pay the most in years. One yield level will decide whether the exodus was smart or a costly mistake for anyone holding the safe 40% of a portfolio.
news.title_zh: 債券 ETF 多年來最具吸引力，為何華爾街卻在拋售？
news.summary_zh: 投資人正逃離債券基金，就在此時新債券殖利率創多年新高。某一殖利率水準將決定這波出逃對持有投資組合安全 40% 的人來說，是明智之舉還是昂貴錯誤。

news.title: Some Fed Officials Wanted to Hike in October. A Half-Point Hike Is on the Table.
news.summary: Fed minutes revealed a hawkish bloc bigger than the October vote let on, and Governor Waller says the central bank may need to shock people. Long bond holders now face a fork where one path rescues them and the other keeps squeezing.
news.title_zh: 部分聯準會官員想在十月升息。半碼升息在考慮範圍內。
news.summary_zh: 聯準會會議記錄揭示鷹派陣營比十月投票顯示的更大，Waller 總裁表示央行可能需要震懾市場。長債持有者現在面臨岔路，一條路能救他們，另一條則持續擠壓。

news.title: Fed Hawks Turn Up Heat As Inflation Fears Grow
news.summary: The Treasury market has been pricing in higher odds for a series of rate hikes for months.
news.title_zh: 聯準會鷹派加碼施壓，通膨恐懼升溫
news.summary_zh: 公債市場數月來已將連續加息的機率大幅提高。

news.title: Two More Days Above 5% and Treasury Yields Tie 2007’s Run
news.summary: The 10-year yield has spent four straight sessions above a line it rarely crosses, and a bond auction plus Fed minutes arrive within hours. Whether the streak survives could decide what happens next for long-bond holders.
news.title_zh: 再維持 5% 以上兩天，公債殖利率將追平 2007 的紀錄
news.summary_zh: 10 年期殖利率已連續四個交易日站上鮮少觸及的關鍵線，且債券拍賣與聯準會會議紀錄將在數小時內公布。這波連續漲勢能否延續，將決定長債持有者的後續走向。

news.title: Traders Now See a 95% Chance the Fed Hikes Rates in December
news.summary: A December hike looks like a lock, yet the Treasury market that matters most for long-bond holders answers to a different signal. Fed officials are split on how far this cycle runs, and TLT owners may be watching the wrong number.
news.title_zh: 交易員現在認為聯準會在十二月升息的機率為 95%
news.summary_zh: 十二月升息看起來鐵定會發生，但對長期債券持有者最重要的國債市場卻回應不同的訊號。聯準會官員對這輪循環能走多遠意見分歧，TLT 持有者可能正在關注錯誤的數字。

news.title: Charting The Year Ahead: Investment Ideas For 2027
news.summary: As AI concentration reshapes markets, investors can find diversifying strategies to broaden opportunities while still seeking attractive returns.
news.title_zh: 展望來年：2027 投資構想
news.summary_zh: 隨著 AI 集中度重塑市場，投資人可尋找多元化策略擴大機會，同時仍追求吸引人報酬。

news.title: The Government Spends About $5.5 Billion a Day More Than It Takes In. The Debt Has Doubled in 10 Years. Jaime Dimon This the Situation Could Get Much Worse.
news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Why 5% Bond Yields Are More Attractive Than The S&P 500, And Will Be For A While
news.summary: The bull case for hedged bonds: a 5% target baseline offers a head start as 5-10 year S&P 500 returns may be closer to 0% than 15%.
news.title_zh: 為什麼 5% 債券殖利率比標普 500 更具吸引力，且短期內將持續如此
news.summary_zh: 對沖債券的多頭論點：5% 目標基準提供先發優勢，因為 5-10 年標普 500 回報可能更接近 0% 而非 15%。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.

news.title_zh: Nvidia 股價將面臨自 2008 以來未見的連續週線下跌
news.summary_zh: 一位基金經理表示，持續的不確定性使 Nvidia 面臨更多拋售壓力，儘管該公司在過去七天已抹去超過 $900 billion 的市值。

news.title: Former Nvidia CEO Huang agreed to testify at public US Senate hearing, senator’s aide says
news.title_zh: 據參議員助理稱，前 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳同意在美國參議院公開聽證會作證

news.title: Trump says Huang should apologize and return to Nvidia
news.title_zh: 川普表示黃仁勳應道歉並回歸輝達

news.title: SpaceX Just Raised $32 Billion for AI Chips. Lenders Want Elon Musk to Keep Them on Earth.
news.summary: SpaceX had to pay a yield above 8% on the biggest piece of a $32 billion bond sale to buy Nvidia chips.
news.title_zh: SpaceX 才剛募集 $32 Billion 購買 AI 晶片。債權人希望馬斯克讓它們留在地球上。
news.summary_zh: SpaceX 在 $32 billion 債券發行的最大部分，必須支付高於 8% 的殖利率，以購買輝達晶片。

news.title: Nvidia Sinks 7% on New Probes as California AG Says Scandal “Raises Bright Red Flags”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNvidia shares fell 7% after California’s attorney general subpoenaed the company and lawmakers opened a probe. Both probes ask whether Nvidia’s chips reached China and what investors were told.
news.title_zh: 輝達因新調查下跌 7%，加州檢察長稱醜聞「亮起紅燈警訊」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要輝達股價下跌 7%，因加州檢察長傳喚該公司且立法者展開調查。兩項調查都詢問輝達晶片是否流入中國，以及投資人被告知了什麼。

news.title: Nvidia Is Headed for Its 7th Straight Daily Decline. History Says This Happens Next
news.summary: Nvidia could be headed for its longest losing streak ever.
news.title_zh: 輝達將迎來第 7 個連續下跌交易日。歷史顯示接下來會發生什麼
news.summary_zh: 輝達可能面臨史上最長連跌紀錄。

news.title: Nvidia Falls Behind Alphabet, Loses $2.3 Trillion In Market Value Since October Peak
news.summary: Alphabet’s market value stood at approximately $3.44 trillion, compared with $3.41 trillion for Nvidia, a difference of about $30 billion.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 落後 Alphabet，自十月高點以來市值蒸發 $2.3 Trillion
news.summary_zh: Alphabet 的市值約為 $3.44 trillion，而 Nvidia 為 $3.41 trillion，差距約 $30 billion。

news.title: Between IREN and CoreWeave Here’s Who Has the Cleaner Path to a Sustained 30% Rebound
news.summary: Both AI cloud darlings tumbled after NVIDIA flashed a warning on financing, yet one sits on billions in customer prepayments while the other still hunts a $6B funding gap. Which stock can actually power a lasting comeback?
news.title_zh: 在 IREN 和 CoreWeave 之間，誰擁有更清晰的路徑實現持續的 30% 反彈
news.summary_zh: 在 NVIDIA 發出融資警告後，兩家 AI 雲端寵兒股價雙雙暴跌，但一家擁有數十億美元客戶預付款，另一家仍在尋覓 $6B 資金缺口。哪檔股票真能推動持久反彈？

news.title: Trump Bought Up to $265,000 of NVIDIA Stock. Here’s Where the Price Target Stands
news.summary: A presidential stock purchase lands the same week NVIDIA loses its CEO and sinks toward a 52-week low. Behind the chaos sits a record quarter and a valuation that looks oddly cheap next to AMD and Broadcom.
news.title_zh: Trump 買入高達 $265,000 的 NVIDIA 股票。這裡是目標價的現況
news.summary_zh: 總統買入股票的消息傳出的同一週，NVIDIA 失去 CEO 並跌向 52 週低點。混亂背後是創紀錄的季度業績，以及與 AMD 和 Broadcom 相比顯得異常便宜的估值。

news.title: Nvidia Earns “Highest Risk” as Focus Turns to New Semis Trade
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNVIDIA closed at a 52-week low on Nov. 19, down 39% from its high, two days after reporting $115.
news.title_zh: Nvidia 獲評「最高風險」 隨著焦點轉向新半導體交易
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 NVIDIA 收盤於 52 週低點，於 Nov. 19，較高點下跌 39%，在報告 $115 兩天後。

news.summary: Mounting regulatory concerns, elevated valuations, and uncertainty surrounding interest rates are putting some of Wall Street's biggest winners of the AI boom under considerable pressure.
news.title_zh: 股市盤中，Nov. 20：納斯達克暴跌近 3%，AMD 和美光領跌慘烈半導體賣盤
news.summary_zh: 日增的監管憂慮、高估值，以及利率不確定性，正讓華爾街 AI 熱潮中的最大贏家承受相當大壓力。

news.title: Trump Bought Up to $265,000 of NVIDIA Stock. Here’s Where the Price Target Stands

news.title: AMD Sinks Another 4% as Chip Rout Deepens After Short Report Flags “Its Own China Problem”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD fell another 4% today, after an 8% drop on Hunterbrook Media’s report tying its firmware to a blacklisted Chinese server maker. Arm and Navitas fell too, so the selling looks bigger than AMD.
news.title_zh: AMD 再度下跌 4% 晶片股崩盤加深 空頭報告指稱「自身中國問題」
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 今日再跌 4%，此前因 Hunterbrook Media 報告將其韌體與被列入黑名單的中國伺服器製造商連結，股價下跌 8%。Arm 和 Navitas 也下跌，因此拋售範圍似乎超出 AMD。

news.title: AMD Slides 6% Despite Jim Cramer Calling Hunterbrook Short Report a ‘Hitjob’; NVIDIA Falls 3% Near Damodaran’s $140 Buy Price, Intel Declines 2%
news.summary: A short seller says AMD's ties to a blacklisted Chinese server maker expose it to export crackdowns, and a famous TV defender can't stop the bleeding. Now NVIDIA and Intel are caught in the same China-driven chip selloff.
news.title_zh: AMD 下滑 6% 儘管吉姆·克拉默稱亨特布魯克做空報告為「打擊行動」；輝達跌至 3% 接近達莫達蘭的 $140 買入價格，英特爾下跌 2%
news.summary_zh: 一名做空者稱 AMD 與一家被列入黑名單的中國伺服器製造商的關係使其面臨出口打壓，一位知名電視評論員也無法阻止股價下跌。現在輝達和英特爾也陷入同樣由中國驅動的晶片拋售潮中。

news.title: The U.S. Approved 879,000 Nvidia and AMD Chips for China in 6 Months
news.summary: Newly released Commerce Department records show who Washington quietly cleared to buy advanced AI chips, and some names appear on the Pentagon's military company list. Nvidia's guidance says it doesn't matter, but a December hearing could change that.
news.title_zh: 美國在 6 個月內批准 879,000 輝達和 AMD 晶片銷往中國

news.title: If AMD Grows at 15% a Year, Here’s What $5,000 Could Become by 2030
news.summary: AMD has more than doubled this year, yet the models behind its stock see a surprisingly wide gap between the best and worst outcomes. Which path your money follows depends on one stubborn question about AI demand and a valuation that already prices in plenty.
news.title_zh: 若 AMD 每年按 15% 成長，這裡展示 $5,000 到 2030 可能變成什麼樣
news.summary_zh: AMD 今年股價翻倍以上，但其股價背後的模型顯示最佳與最差結果之間存在驚人差距。您的資金將走向哪條路徑，取決於一個關於 AI 需求的棘手問題，以及已經包含大量預期的估值。

news.title: Jim Cramer Says He’s Buying AMD After a Short Seller’s 15% Hit
news.summary: A short report wiped out AMD's entire post-earnings gain in one session, yet its own author admits he can't say whether any rule was broken. Does a case that thin deserve a buyer's attention, or is Washington the real threat?
news.title_zh: Jim Cramer 表示在做空者 15% 打擊後買入 AMD
news.summary_zh: 一份做空報告在一個交易時段內抹平 AMD 所有財報後漲幅，但其作者自己承認無法說明是否違反任何規則。這麼薄弱的案例值得買方關注，還是華盛頓才是真正威脅？

news.title: AMD Stock Drops Another 7% Before the Bell and Taiwan Semiconductor Slides 4.2% as Nasdaq Futures Fall 1.6% After Asia’s Chip Selloff
news.summary: AMD was down another 7% before Friday's opening bell and Taiwan Semiconductor 4.2% after Taiwan's worst week since 1991. Nasdaq 100 futures were down 1.6% while Dow futures were flat. Here is what Asia's selloff means for the U.S. open.
news.title_zh: AMD 股票開盤前再跌 7%，台積電下滑 4.2%，納斯達克期貨跌 1.6%，亞洲晶片拋售後
news.summary_zh: AMD 在週五開盤鐘響前再跌 7%，台積電 4.2%，此前台灣經歷自 1991 以來最糟一週。納斯達克 100 期貨下跌 1.6%，道瓊期貨持平。這裡說明亞洲拋售對美股開盤的意義。

news.title: Why Is AMD Down 5% In Premarket Today?

news.summary_zh: 在報導質疑其中國業務後，AMD 跌勢延續第二天，儘管分析師認為指控缺乏依據。

news.summary_zh: Anthropic 在股價遠高於配售價 $83 開始交易後，迅速成為全球最有價值上市公司之一。

news.summary: AMD fell almost 8% on Thursday, erasing roughly $67 billion of market value, and slid again after hours. A short seller's China report, investors selling to buy Anthropic and a market reversal all hit at once. Here is what each one means for holders.
news.title_zh: AMD 剛暴跌近 8%，損失 $67 Billion 盤後續跌。做空者稱其面臨輝達同樣的中國風險
news.summary_zh: AMD 週四暴跌近 8%，蒸發約 $67 billion 市值，盤後再度下滑。做空者的中國報告、投資者拋售買入 Anthropic 以及市場反轉同時襲來。這對持有者各意味著什麼。

news.title: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
news.summary: Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed the latest from Apple with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney. Apple Inc. is developing its own autonomous artificial intelligence agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Meta Platforms Inc. and others. The company outlined the plans in job listings added to its website this week. In one, Apple said it’s seeking a senior engineering manager for a proactive, agentic AI assistant. The system will write code, browse the web, control apps and navigate devices on a user’s behalf, according to the post. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple Working on Own AI Agent to Rival OpenAI and Anthropic
news.summary: Anurag Rana, Senior Tech Analyst for Bloomberg Intelligence, discussed the latest from Apple with Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney. Apple Inc. is developing its own autonomous artificial intelligence agent that can get things done on behalf of users, looking to enter a fast-growing market already being pursued by OpenAI, Anthropic PBC, Meta Platforms Inc. and others. The company outlined the plans in job listings added to its website this week. In one, Apple said it’s seeking a senior engineering manager for a proactive, agentic AI assistant. The system will write code, browse the web, control apps and navigate devices on a user’s behalf, according to the post. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.summary: Marvell and Intel have both lost more than half their value since June. At Tuesday's close on Nov 17, Marvell stood at $148.74. That is 53.0% below its high close of $316.43 on June 4. news.summary_zh: 自六月以來，Marvell 和 Intel 都已損失超過一半價值。在 Nov 17 星期二收盤時，Marvell 報 $148.74。這比其在 June 4 的高點收盤價 $316.43 低 53.0%。Intel 收於 $55.17，比其 June 22 高點低 60.9%。關於晶片股拋售的大多數論調要么是逢低買入的呼籲，要么是 AI 交易結束的警告。本文探討一個更窄的問題：當晶片股腰斬時，有多大機率能回到高點，以及需要多久時間。

news.title: Lumentum Is Down 33% in a Month as Marvell’s Slide Shrinks Its Buyout Value. Can LITE Stock Get Back to Bernstein’s $700 Target?
news.summary: Lumentum posted record revenue and a blockbuster outlook, yet its stock keeps sinking anyway. A fixed-ratio merger clause ties its fate to someone else's share price, and that changes what a recovery would actually require.
news.title_zh: Lumentum 一月下跌 33%，因 Marvell 下滑縮減其收購價值。LITE 股票能否回到 Bernstein 的 $700 目標價？
news.summary_zh: Lumentum 發布創紀錄營收和強勁展望，但其股價仍持續下跌。固定比例合併條款將其命運繫於他人股價，這改變了復甦實際所需的條件。

news.title: Astera Labs and Credo Each Trade About 60% Below Their Highs. Only One Still Needs a $1.46 Billion Second Half
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAstera Labs and Credo Technology both trade roughly 60% below their highs, but Astera has already delivered its ramp. Credo still needs at least $1.

news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點：Astera Labs 和 Credo Technology 交易價格均約低於高點 60%，但 Astera 已實現其增長。Credo 仍至少需要 $1。

news.title: Applied Materials vs. Marvell Technology: Which Tech Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
news.summary: Two chipmakers, two very different bets: one sells the tools that build the chips, the other designs the networking silicon that moves data between them.

news.summary_zh: 兩家晶片製造商，兩種截然不同的押注：一家銷售製造晶片的工具，另一家設計在晶片間移動數據的網路矽晶片。

news.title: Nvidia’s Board Has Considered the CEOs of Arm and Marvell to Replace Huang
news.summary: Nvidia posted a blowout quarter, yet the boardroom story overshadowed it. Two rival chip CEOs reportedly sit on the shortlist, three directors want Huang back, and one of those executives is deep in a $115 billion merger.

news.summary_zh: Nvidia 發布超預期財報，董事會內幕卻蓋過風頭。據報導，兩位競爭對手晶片執行長列入候選名單，三名董事希望黃仁勳留任，而其中一位高管正深陷 $115 billion 併購案中。

news.title: Could $1,000 in Oklo Stock Set You Up for Life by 2035?
news.summary: Oklo stock is as jittery as an electron. Can this volatile nuclear stock deliver explosive gains by 2035?
news.title_zh: 投資 $1,000 於 Oklo 股票能否讓你在 2035 前財務自由？
news.summary_zh: Oklo 股票如電子般顛簸。這檔波動大的核能股能否在 2035 前帶來爆發性漲幅？

news.title: Oklo Just Dropped 22% in a Month. What Would It Take to Get OKLO Stock to $25?
news.summary: Oklo has no operating power plant, a $3.1 billion cash cushion, and a stock that keeps sliding while Wall Street's targets sit far above it. The real question is which milestones could change the story, and which could break it.
news.title_zh: Oklo 一個月內下跌 22%。要讓 OKLO 股價達到 $25 需要什麼條件？
news.summary_zh: Oklo 沒有營運中的發電廠，擁有 $3.1 billion 現金緩衝，股價持續下滑，而華爾街的目標價遠高於此。真正的問題是哪些里程碑能改變劇本，哪些會讓它崩盤。

news.title: NuScale Sinks 22% in a Week to a 52-Week Low as Canada’s First SMR Runs Late. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale fell 22% in a week to a 52-week low after Canada’s first GE Vernova Hitachi small modular reactor ran late and over budget. Oklo fell too, but NuScale, still without a binding module order, fell about twice as much.
news.title_zh: NuScale 下跌 22% 於一週內至 52 週低點，因加拿大首座 SMR 延遲。賣壓是否過度？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要NuScale 一週內下跌 22%，跌至 52 週低點，因加拿大首座 GE Vernova Hitachi 小型模組化反應爐延遲且超支。Oklo 也下跌，但 NuScale 仍無具約束力的模組訂單，跌幅約為其兩倍。

news.title: Meta’s Prepayment Is Buying Oklo’s Nuclear Fuel for Up to Five Reactors
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo (OKLO) signed definitive agreements with Centrus Energy (LEU) on November 12 to secure enough nuclear fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta Platforms (META) is helping finance fuel purchases for Oklo’s planned 1.
news.title_zh: Meta 的預付款正在為 Oklo 的最多五座反應堆購買核燃料
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo (OKLO) 於 November 12 與 Centrus Energy (LEU) 簽署最終協議，確保最多五座 Aurora 發電廠所需的核燃料，交付將於 2029 開始。Meta Platforms (META) 正在協助為 Oklo 計劃的 1 融資採購燃料。

news.title: Oklo Sits Near Its 52-Week Low After a 5-Reactor Fuel Deal. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo signed definitive contracts with Centrus Energy for enough HALEU to run up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta’s prepayment for future power supports the purchase, and Centrus now counts $5.
news.title_zh: Oklo 處於其 52 週低點附近，在 5 反應爐燃料交易後。是賣出還是加碼時機？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Oklo 與 Centrus Energy 簽署最終合約，取得足夠 HALEU 燃料最多運轉五座 Aurora 電廠，交貨自 2029 開始。Meta 為未來電力預付款支持採購，Centrus 現計有 $5。

news.title: Oklo Has Lost 76% in a Year. Wall Street Still Sees $56. Bullish Wedbush Sees Just $36
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo has lost 76% in a year, and analysts’ average price target has fallen from $103 to $56. Wedbush repeated its Outperform rating and $36 target on Nov.
news.title_zh: Oklo 一年虧損 76%。華爾街仍看好 $56。看漲的 Wedbush 僅看 $36
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo 一年虧損 76%，分析師平均目標價已從 $103 to $56 下調。Wedbush 重申其跑贏大盤評級及 $36 目標價，於十一月。

news.title: AMD Soars 6%, Broadcom Up 6% as Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Exits
news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 6% after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Broadcom rose with it. IonQ, SoundHound and Oklo fell instead, as investors cut back on the riskiest AI bets.
news.title_zh: AMD 飆漲 6%，Broadcom 上漲 6%，隨著 Nvidia CEO 黃仁勳離職
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點 AMD 股價在黃仁勳辭去 Nvidia CEO 後跳升 6%，Broadcom 同步上漲。IonQ、SoundHound 和 Oklo 則下跌，因投資人減碼最具風險的 AI 押注。

news.title: Craig-Hallum Just Cut Its Oklo Target From $53 to $27 After a Better-Than-Expected Quarter
news.summary: Key TakeawaysCraig-Hallum cut its Oklo price target to $27 from $53 on Nov. 9 and kept its Hold rating, three days after Oklo reported a narrower third-quarter loss than expected.
news.title_zh: Craig-Hallum 在優於預期的季度後將 Oklo 目標價從 $53 to $27 下調
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Craig-Hallum 於 Nov. 9 將 Oklo 目標價從 $53 下調至 $27，並維持持有評級，這是在 Oklo 報告第三季虧損縮小優於預期的三天後。

news.summary_zh: DOE 的運營限制許可將允許反應爐進入研究、測試和訓練階段。

news.title: Oklo Rises 4% as DOE Clears Groves-1 Reactor for Unrestricted Operations: “Reset the Nuclear Industry’s Expectations”
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo shares jumped 4% today after the Department of Energy cleared its Groves-1 test reactor for unrestricted operations. Groves-1 shows Oklo can build fast, but it still needs a cost for its first Aurora powerhouse and a binding customer.
news.title_zh: Oklo 上漲 4%，因 DOE 核准 Groves-1 反應爐進行無限制運營：「重設核能產業期望」
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要Oklo 股價今日跳升 4%，因能源部核准其 Groves-1 試驗反應爐進行無限制運營。Groves-1 顯示 Oklo 能快速建設，但仍需首座 Aurora 電廠的成本和具約束力的客戶。

news.summary: Oklo Inc. (NYSE:OKLO) announced that the US Department of Energy (DOE) has cleared the final operations hold point for its Groves Isotope Test Reactor (Groves-1) in Lockhart, Texas, allowing the facility to proceed with research, testing and personnel training activities.

news.title: South Korea’s Stock Market and the Nikkei 225 Sink More Than 4% as the AI Selloff Spreads From Wall Street. Here’s How Much of a Target-Date Fund Is in Samsung, SK Hynix and TSMC
news.summary: South Korea's KOSPI and Japan's Nikkei 225 both sank more than 4% on Friday as Wall Street's AI selloff spread to Asia. Samsung, SK hynix and TSMC are about 1.7% of a 2030 target-date fund, and South Korea is 1.38%, so the Seoul drop comes to about $348 on a $500,000 balance.
news.title_zh: 南韓股市與日經 225 下跌超過 4%，隨著 AI 拋售潮從華爾街蔓延。目標日期基金中三星、SK 海力士和台積電的佔比有多少
news.summary_zh: 南韓 KOSPI 和日本日經 225 週五雙雙下跌超過 4%，隨著華爾街的 AI 拋售潮蔓延至亞洲。三星、SK 海力士和台積電約佔一檔 2030 目標日期基金的 1.7%，而南韓佔 1.38%，因此首爾股市下跌對 $500,000 餘額的影響約為 $348。

news.title: Sandisk Sinks 21% in a Week as Nvidia’s CEO Exit Hits Memory Stocks. Time to Buy?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSandisk fell 21% in the past week on no news of its own, as Jensen Huang’s Nvidia exit dragged down memory stocks, Micron and SK hynix included. Analysts still expect Sandisk’s earnings to more than triple this fiscal year, yet it trades near its lowest forward P/E in a year.

news.summary: IREN Ltd (NASDAQ:IREN) shares surged 7. 2% in US premarket trading on Wednesday, supported by stronger-than-expected quarterly earnings from Nvidia, renewed confidence in artificial intelligence infrastructure spending and a broader recovery across specialised AI cloud computing companies.
news.title: Why Is IREN Stock Surging Today?

news.summary: “We have supported the development of this ecosystem, and we will continue to be disciplined and selective in our support," Nvidia CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress said.
news.title_zh: 輝達釋放 AI 融資飛輪將持續，但「紀律嚴明」：分析師稱 Neoclouds 為其「最大持續押注」，NBIS、IREN、MRVL 上漲
news.summary_zh: 「我們已支持該生態系發展，並將繼續在支持上保持紀律嚴明和審慎選擇，」輝達財務長暨暫代執行長 Colette Kress 說。

news.title: IREN Nearly Tripled AI Cloud Revenue to $200 Million. Can It Be “Delivered, Financed, and Run at a Profit”?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysIREN’s AI cloud revenue nearly tripled to $200 million last quarter, lifting total revenue 66% sequentially to $228 million. IREN moved its $4 billion annualized revenue target into January 2027 after Microsoft requested network changes, and it could slip to late February.

news.summary_zh: 重點摘要IREN 的 AI 雲端營收上季近乎翻三倍達 $200 million，推動總營收按季 66% 至 $228 million。在微軟要求網路變更後，IREN 將其 $4 billion 年化營收目標推遲至 January 2027，並可能再延至二月底。

news.title: IREN Is Down 63% in a Year. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?

news.title_zh: IREN 一年下跌 63%。是賣出時機，還是加碼買入？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要IREN 股價在過去一年下跌 63%。對債務融資擴建的擔憂衝擊 CoreWeave 及其他 AI 雲端建設者，而 IREN 自身的建設持續需要更多資金。

news.title: IREN Is the Real Loser in Nvidia’s Pullback: Nvidia Is Its $3.4 Billion Customer

IREN looks more exposed than most companies, since Nvidia will rent about $700 million a year of cloud capacity from it under a five-year, $3.
news.title_zh: IREN 是輝達回調中的真正輸家：輝達是其 $3.4 Billion 客戶
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點輝達預計將減緩對 AI 公司的投資及其信用擔保，因為 Jensen Huang 已辭去 CEO 一職，The Information 報導。IREN 比大多數公司更受影響，因為輝達將在一份為期五年的 $3 下，每年從其租用約 $700 million 的雲端產能。
